messages:
maria: Quick postmortem follow-up: during last night's incident we lost ~20% of spans for a 45m window, aggregation counts were off (window_alignment bug) and the ETL backfill queued up causing analytics lag. We need owners + concrete milestones.

josh: I'll pick up the tracer-side fix. Found that the sampler dropper filter is accidentally applied twice when retry_count>0, which drops spans from retried requests. Plan: remove duplicate filter invocation, add end-to-end trace replay test. ETA: 2026-04-02.

rachel: I'll own aggregation correctness. The tumbling-window job was aligning windows to UTC+1 due to a timezone cast in the SQL, causing off-by-one buckets. Also saw implicit float truncation in rate calculations. Plan: fix SQL, add property tests + parity checks against raw events. ETA: 2026-03-30 for patch, canary 2026-03-31.

ben: I'll take ETL resilience. Symptoms point to write stalls in the parquet commit layer when Bigtable GC runs at 03:00 UTC; I'll add commit retries and monitor commit latency. Also will add a fast-path replay for late partitions. ETA: instrument 03/28, replay job 04/01.

ops-bot: Postmortem created: https://redwoodinternal/postmortems/1774001234 - add notes there.

maria: Please paste acceptance criteria here for each item so we can close the postmortem. Also propose a follow-up sync.

josh: Acceptance: unit + e2e replay test demonstrating 1000 synthetic traces with no missing spans; add metric span_drop_rate and alert at >5% for 10m; PR 4712 when ready.

rachel: Acceptance: SQL fixes merged + nightly parity job comparing aggregated results vs raw every hour for 24h with <0.1% diff; rollback plan and canary (10% traffic) documented.

ben: Acceptance: automated retry on commit failures with exponential backoff (3 retries), metric commit_failures, and a replay job that can backfill N days via partition filter.

maria: I also want a root-cause doc outlining recurring patterns. We've seen similar midnight spikes 4x in 60 days. Let's add a recurring-incident tag and weekly detection summary to #eng-ops.

ops-bot: Weekly detection scheduled at 07:00 UTC every Monday to post top-5 ingestion anomalies to #eng-ops.

maria: OK. Proposed follow-up review: 2026-04-07 16:00 UTC. Add blockers here if anyone needs to shift dates.

josh: Accepted. If tests need infra, ping me; otherwise on track for 04/02.

rachel: Accepted. I'll also add the failing SQL example to the regression corpus.

ben: Accepted. I'll run a dry-run of the replay on staging 03/30 and post logs.

maria: Checklist (copy into postmortem):
- josh: tracer dedupe bug fix + replay tests + span_drop_rate metric 44D ETA 2026-04-02
- rachel: SQL timezone + float fixes + parity checks + canary plan 4C5 ETA 2026-03-30 (canary 03/31)
- ben: parquet commit retries + replay job + commit_failures metric 527 ETA 2026-03-28 / 2026-04-01
- ops: weekly anomaly digest for recurring windows 514 weekly

ops-bot: Incident board updated: https://redwoodinternal/boards/incidents/4712 (owners assigned).

josh: quick snippet of the dup filter issue:
```
# pseudocode
if retry_count > 0:
  apply_sampler_drop()  # first application
# ... later in pipeline ...
apply_sampler_drop()  # accidentally applied again
```

josh: fix will ensure single application and add guard flag.

rachel: SQL diff preview: changed `TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(event_ts, HOUR, 'UTC+01:00')` -> `TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(event_ts, HOUR, 'UTC')` and normalized casts to DOUBLE for rate math.

ben: replay dry-run plan: run partitioned query with limit per partition, validate row counts vs expected, do not write unless --commit flag set.

maria: Thanks all. I'll own the follow-up review and mark the postmortem as "monitoring" until parity window completes. Ping here if anything slips.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up review on 2026-04-07 16:00 UTC.
